# DLMM Bot

> Automated Meteora DLMM liquidity bot for Solana. Paper first. Burner wallet only.

Site: https://dlmmbot.com
Docs: https://dlmmbot.com/setup/
For AI agents (install playbook): https://dlmmbot.com/setup/agents
GitHub: https://github.com/CryptoGnome/dlmmbot
License: PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 (https://github.com/CryptoGnome/dlmmbot/blob/main/LICENSE) — run/study/modify for your own use; no competing product
Terms / risk waiver: https://dlmmbot.com/setup/terms (https://github.com/CryptoGnome/dlmmbot/blob/main/TERMS.md) — required in setup; as-is, no liability for losses
Railway signup: https://railway.com?referralCode=SCj9lN
Vultr VPS signup: https://www.vultr.com/?ref=9917878-9J
Helius RPC (recommended): https://www.helius.dev/
Jupiter API key: https://developers.jup.ag/portal
GMGN API key: https://gmgn.ai/ai (optional — see docs/setup/api-keys)

## Agent quickstart

1. Read this file, then https://dlmmbot.com/llms-full.txt
2. Follow https://dlmmbot.com/setup/agents (preferred) and https://dlmmbot.com/setup/easy
3. Fork `CryptoGnome/dlmmbot` → deploy **the fork** on Railway → canvas `+ Add` → Volume → mount `/app/data` → generate domain → open dashboard with `DASH_TOKEN`
4. Human accepts Terms in wizard; paste Helius `RPC_URL` + Jupiter key; create burner; stay paper unless they explicitly ask for live
5. Never commit secrets; never use a main wallet; live needs both `FARMER_MODE=live` and `[exec].mode = "live"`

## Product facts

- Scans SOL-quoted Meteora DLMM pools, vets tokens, opens one-sided SOL LP, exits by fixed rules
- Dashboard: overview, book, analytics, activity, errors, research, wiki (strategy/ops manual), changes, settings (majors allowlist ticker search on Meteora)
- Update toasts when GitHub is ahead or the bot restarts on a new build; BEHIND build pill pulses
- Errors tab streams structured runtime errors over WebSocket (copy dump / open GitHub issue)
- Token symbols show Jupiter / Pump.fun / DexScreener icons (cached in SQLite + browser)
- Header ON/OFF (soft pause) + HALT (close-all); Changes shows risk tags on pending commits
- Auto-update on by default (PM2); header Auto switch (next to build pill) can require Approve on Changes before pull
- **Settings profiles:** official Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive; local saves on the volume; community gallery. Share guide: https://dlmmbot.com/setup/profiles (browser fork + PR; works on Railway)
- First-run setup wizard: accept Terms & risk waiver, RPC, encrypted wallet (create or Phantom import with password retype + one-time backup), paper/live mode
- Existing installs without an accepted terms version get a blocking Terms prompt
- Live requires both `FARMER_MODE=live` and `[exec].mode = "live"`
- **Usage fee:** see https://dlmmbot.com/setup/fees — 1% of live wins buys/burns GNME (existing CryptoGnome mining-game token; not a new bot token)
- Runtime config/env/db live under gitignored `data/` (repo `config.toml` is a template)
- Optional Railway `WALLET_PASSPHRASE` auto-unlocks encrypted wallet on boot
- Not financial advice; memecoin LP can lose 100%; Terms waiver required (https://dlmmbot.com/setup/terms)
